changes_vs_current: Computed order (mean position over 8 people sources; a missing item scores that list's length +5): 1 Tiger, 2 Elephant, 3 Lion, 4 Dolphin, 5 Giraffe, 6 Whale, 7 Penguin, 8 Polar Bear, 9 Panda, 10 Gorilla, 11 Leopard, 12 Cheetah, 13 Otter, 14 Koala, 15 Turtle, 16 Hippo, 17 Seal, 18 Monkey, 19 Zebra, 20 Jaguar, 21 Meerkat, 22 Bear, 23 Red Panda, 24 Snow Leopard, then Wolf, Kangaroo, Snake, Lemur, Parrot, Sea Lion, Rhino, Shark. Topic edits: Whale (#6) dropped because it is not a zoo animal (the board is zoo animals). Dolphin moved from #4 to #16: it is an aquarium/marine animal, and its high marks come from general favorite-animal polls, not zoo polls; it stays on the board because AYTM's zoos-and-aquariums survey has it #2. Seal and Sea Lion merged into one item (Sea Lion, alias seal), placed #19. Snow Leopard is folded into Leopard as an alias instead of being its own item. Gut-check moves: Monkey moved from #18 to #5. It is #1 in the only US zoo must-see poll (AYTM 53%) and 14% in the Buffalo museum survey; its low spot comes from the UK YouGov rating (4/10). Zebra moved from #19 to #10, because it is a classic zoo answer and appears in two sources (YouGov 5, pet-size poll) that never put it low. Bear moved from #22 to #12: AYTM has it 25% (#8) and it is a gut-check item. Kangaroo moved from #26 to #15 because of Explore 2026 (32%, tied with elephant). Hippo moved from #16 to #13 because of Explore search (#2 worldwide). Rhino moved from #31 to #21 as a standard zoo animal (YouGov 3). Leopard (#11 to #14), Koala, Otter, Turtle, Jaguar and Red Panda moved down to make room. Meerkat stays at about #20. Chimpanzee, Wolf, Snake, Snow Leopard (now a Leopard alias), Flamingo and Alligator/Crocodile are the first ones left off.
confidence: medium-high for 1-12 (Tiger/Elephant/Lion/Giraffe are consistent across sources; Monkey, Zebra and Bear rest partly on the gut check); low-medium for 13-24. Caveats: no recent US 'favorite zoo animal' poll with a long list exists. Sources mix US, UK and global, and several are old (2004-2015). Ranker and Wikipedia pageview data could not be fetched (401/429).
